html:
Etchmiadzin Cathedral is the mother church of the Armenian Apostolic Church, at Vagharshapat west of Yerevan, first built around 301 to 303 by Saint Gregory the Illuminator, often called the oldest cathedral in the world.

The name means the place where the Only Begotten descended: Gregory saw Christ come down and mark the spot. The building was rebuilt in its cross domed form in the 480s and added to many times. From 1441 it has been the seat of the Catholicos, the head of the church, who leads Armenians across the world. Under Persian, Russian and Soviet rule it kept the church at the centre of national life. With nearby churches and the ruins of Zvartnots, it is a World Heritage Site.
sum: Etchmiadzin Cathedral is the mother church of the Armenian Apostolic Church, at Vagharshapat west of Yerevan, first built around 301 to 303 by Saint Gregory the Illuminator, often called the oldest cathedral in the world.
